senses.gloss:
ञ The nasal attached to the class of palatal letters, having some-
thing like the sound of N in the French word Singe, and express-
ed by the letter accented N.

ञ m. (-ञः)
 1. A name of SUKRA, regent of Venus.
 2. An ox.
 3. A
heretic, an apostate.
 4. Singing.
 5. Jingling or inarticulate sound.
